name: Knee-less steered relay on the knuckle chain (J3 re-seated on a GH ray, own-angle stops q2 <= 100 / J3 [-100,115], one rigid member 3 to a T-nut carriage on an arm-fixed slotted shell)
family: spherical 4R with a one-sided cuff relay on the knuckle chain, knee-less (rigid cuff)
bench: envsel exact (the round's selection bench; no Bench(60,160) or claim bench run: the pre-registered step-0 kill fired)

mechanism.notes: phi40-thinstack-relay-4r's record minus its cuff knee (2 MR63ZZ pairs, knee link, pad, the knee loop) and minus the L-lug bracket (the member-3 bracket is hub 3's lower plate continued down E's line): J1, K (slaved, slipper nose: lobe - bell crank - nose - flank), J2, J3, relay (14 x 14 Ti T-nut carriage in a 1.0 mm slotted Ti shell, constant-force coil on the lug, 1 ISO 8734 zero dowel, slot end = PHI stop, iglidur tape); stops are dowels in existing members (0 parts added). Complexity 51.75 (v2.2) vs phi40 51.25: the knee is free under v2.1/v2.2, so deleting it saves nothing on this ruler.

verdict: DEAD by the pre-registered step-0 kill. The bracket-honest proxy is > 15.4 at every cell; the best is 15.60 at seat (80,-15), PHI 58, s0 -80 (reach 0.803, ib14 0.882, 17 contacts). With the knee-less metal on the phi40 hardware the claim number is 22.39 at s0 -80 (the shell's anterior end hits the torso: 13 hardware contacts) and 22.85 at s0 -55 (the bump over the shell band lifts the chain out of band: ib14 0.825). Both are worse than the 3-joint lead (18.28) and the knee-less 3-joint best (21.07).
limiter: REACH at the relay's saturation: 289/360 workspace poses even at PHI 58, the same 289 at PHI 62 (fold 49, J3 stop 5, and 54 poses with no stop-legal relay angle). Then CONTACT of relayed overhead poses: 13 of 17 contacts are relayed, at elevation 150-167, on hub 2 / L2 / horn. The real metal adds a station dilemma: at s0 -80 the shell's anterior end lies past the torso cliff (clean only to ~+48 deg, measured per 2-deg bin over all poses; the shell needs +67.6 for PHI 58), and at s0 -55 the shell band sits under hub 3 / L2 and the 60-deg bump lifts them out of band.
note: Convergence gate on the 40 bracket-honest (lug) entries in order: gain over the 2nd half 0.0 score points, over the last third 0.0, top-5 spread 0.09 points. The best cell came 3rd of 8 and is pinned on its four seat neighbours. This is a grid on the judge's pre-registered stencil + 4 probes, not a CMA. q2 95 stops and PHI 50 were not run (PHI 54 < 58 < 62-dominated trend, and q2 95 only removes poses). Envsel only: Bench(110,360) and held-out never run (the kill fired first; the held-out split stays untouched). Shoulder slip (the standing price of every rigid-cuff spherical chain) is reported, not re-measured: p95 4.83 / max 5.14 mm at a 3 mm GH offset, ~6.4 / 6.9 mm at 4 mm.
